question: Which of the following terms in the 5S concept refers to creating a habit of maintaining established processes?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sustain**(4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sustain__ refers to creating a habit of maintaining established processes in the 5S concept.
 
• The 5S methodology is a system for organizing spaces so work can be performed efficiently, effectively, and safely.
 
• Sustain is the last step in the 5S system and focuses on maintaining the progress achieved from the other steps.
 
• It involves training and creating discipline to follow the steps consistently.
 
• Without sustain, improvements achieved through the 5S process can erode over time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **5S Concept:**

 
 
• 5S stands for Sort, Set, Shine, Standardize, and Sustain.
 
• Each step builds on the previous one to improve workplace organization and efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Key Benefits of 5S:**
 
 
• Improved safety and reduced waste in the workplace.
 
• Enhanced productivity and employee morale.
